collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TALL TALES AND SELF-INTEREST (TT-01 to TT-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Boasting, stretched stories, little vanities, wanting the credit, the best seat or the bigger half. Most of it is harmless and funny; kind people can be boastful too. Nobody is exposed for the sake of it, and nobody needs a lesson.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A villager keeps suggesting heroic changes to a friend's carving of them: carve it all, or carve what you see.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (friend) is carving a little wooden figure of (subject), at (subject)'s request, showing (subject.him/her) as (subject.he/she) usually is: sitting by the fire, peeling a fruit. Every so often (subject) leans over with a suggestion. Perhaps standing, instead? Gazing out to sea? Holding a big fish? With a seabird on (subject.his/her) shoulder and the wind in (subject.his/her) hair?

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (friend) carves every suggestion. The finished figure shows (subject) standing on a rock, gazing bravely at the horizon, a huge fish in one hand and a seabird on (subject.his/her) shoulder. Everyone who sees it says, "Who's that?" (subject) is completely delighted with it.

o1__text.name: Outcome A
o1__text.text: (friend) carves every suggestion. The finished figure shows (subject) standing on a rock, gazing bravely at the horizon, a huge fish in one hand and a seabird on (subject.his/her) shoulder. Everyone who sees it says, "Who's that?" (subject) is completely delighted with it.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (friend) nods at every suggestion and carves (subject) exactly as (subject.he/she) is: sitting by the fire, peeling a fruit, half smiling. (subject) looks at it for a long time. "That's me," (subject.he/she) says, a little surprised. "That's what I look like when I'm happy." (subject.He/she) keeps it by the door.
